entries.meaningZh: 戏仿的（据parody“诙谐的模仿”按现有形容词词性释读）
entries.en: His parodic speech copied the mayor's solemn pauses and turned every promise into a joke.
entries.zh: 他那段戏仿式的讲话模仿了市长庄重的停顿，把每项承诺都变成了笑话。

entries.meaningZh: 关系正常化（据normalise“使正常化、恢复友好状态”作名词释读）
entries.en: The normalisation of relations began with an exchange of letters between the two villages.
entries.zh: 关系正常化的进程始于两村互通信件。

entries.meaningZh: 无用地（此处为徒劳地；据futile“无用的”作副词释读）
entries.en: She knocked futilely on the locked door while the music inside grew louder.
entries.zh: 她徒劳地敲着锁住的门，与此同时，里面的音乐声越来越大。

entries.meaningZh: 感知者（据perceive“感觉、认知”作施事名词释读）
entries.en: The blurred image looked different to each perceiver, even though everyone saw the same screen.
entries.zh: 尽管每个人看到的都是同一块屏幕，那幅模糊的图像在每位感知者眼中却各不相同。

entries.meaningZh: 球门口（足球球门正前方的紧邻区域）
entries.en: The goalkeeper slipped in the muddy goalmouth but still managed to push the ball away.
entries.zh: 守门员在泥泞的球门前滑了一下，但还是设法把球挡开了。
